_ruling: A retired check that can still report `failure` is indistinguishable from a live one that is broken, and it is why the estate's two real reds went unseen for weeks: noise hides signal. A retired check is DECLARED here, with the reason and the date, so the health run can say '1 red, and it is the declared-retired one' rather than '1 red'. A check NOT listed here is never excused - the declaration is a named exemption, not a hole. Same discipline as data/inline-exit-storage-grant.json and the /games/ prose-link exemption.

retired.reason: It asserted that the manifest was the baseline plus exactly one Apex Tennis entry - a transition that has already happened, so it could never go green again under any subsequent change. Its own header says so. Its four generally-valuable limbs were migrated into tools/validate_games_json.sh in derive-form, so retiring it lost no coverage. Dispatch-only; nothing fires it.
